steps: 1. Condition change on the base record
2. Manager/multiplier deltas from an independent reference value

conditionArrows.note: Applied to base values; temporary skills do not trigger extra arrow bonuses. Aggression is not in the list. GK stats are skipped for non-GK original positions. The arrow UI itself was not run in the study.
conditionArrows.levelMappingNote: The article gives 5-condition tables (groups 0–2) without naming them. The worst→best order and group 0=Awareness, 1=Technical, 2=Physical are INFERRED because the B/A values match the named table exactly (10/15, 6/11, 3/6 at 60; 2/3, 1/2, 1/2 at 95).
conditionArrows.interpolation: t = clamp((rating − 60)/35, 0, 1); delta = trunc(lerp(at60, at95, t)) toward zero; value = clamp(base + delta, 40, 99)
conditionArrows.ratingNote: The base positional rating uses card fields with Boosters off; it is not the squad-screen Overall.

manager.note: Only the table for a manager with proficiency 89 is documented. Other levels are not. The manager-selection model was not reproduced. The article does not say which stats get the adjustment: by default it is applied to all (HYPOTHESIS).
manager.referenceRule: The delta is computed from the reference value (base with training, no condition or skills). A temporary skill does not change the reference or cross thresholds. Training can change the reference.

boosters.note: The article does NOT cover Boosters. They are modelled as post-cap additions (step 5), the only documented channel that reads back above 99. Labelled as a HYPOTHESIS.

pitch.boxHalfWidthNote: The article does not give the box width; the regulation size (40.32 m) is used.
pitch.note: ±18 m from halfway (not the box line). Skill line ≈18.14 m from the box and ≈34.56 m from the goal line. 1000/1000 scaling; configurable scaling not observed.

bonusTypes.temporary: Temporary in-match stat addition: enters the recalculation and goes through the 99 cap.
bonusTypes.local: Local effective ability for one action: applied after readback; not permanent or displayed.
bonusTypes.motion: Motions and downstream parameters: cannot be converted into stat points.
